titulo_ja: こと に なっている
titulo_es: Distinguishing a rule from a personal decision

bloques.titulo: In the case of a person who is a member of the public, the person who is a member of the public is a member of the public, and the person who is a member of the public is a member of the public.
texto: The subject may be omitted, but the source of the rule may be an institution. Do not attribute a collective rule to a private decision.
In this library, the rule is that each person can borrow up to five books.
(I have decided to write a diary every night before sleeping)
